title.narrative: Supporting Subul Al Salam Social Association with two four-wheel drive ambulances for an ambulance center in North Lebanon (Phase II)

description.narrative: 1- Raising the readiness of the ambulance services and the ambulance transport system by supporting the ambulance transport fleet and covering the geographical area by transporting patients and injured people to and from hospitals and contributing to saving their lives and prompt intervention and reducing deaths in all areas benefiting from the project 2- Supporting the steadfastness of the refugee-hosting country in the ambulance services and ambulance transport system, strengthening the field ambulance system and medical referral, and contributing to alleviating suffering on the health side, in order to reach the general goal of providing ambulance services and transport, strengthening the field ambulance system and medical referral, and contributing to alleviating suffering on the health side and raising capacities The ambulance staff and their steadfastness, developing their skills, enhancing the economy for them and the country hosting refugees

Supporting the ambulance system in northern Lebanon with two ambulances, strengthening the field ambulance system, medical referral for Syrian refugees and the host community, and providing ambulance services in northern Lebanon

The readiness of the Subul Al Salam Ambulance Center in the north of Lebanon to provide ambulance services and transport, strengthen the field ambulance system and medical referral by adding two ambulances to the existing staff and providing services to (30) thousand Syrian refugees and the host community in addition to emergency cases on the roads and serving them according to need, and empowering the workforce Specialized
